description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller class 'DocumentController' responsible for handling HTTP API endpoints related to document management tasks such as uploading documents, uploading new versions, retrieving documents by ID, and fetching version history in a receipt and expense management platform.

classes.name: DocumentController
classes.description: A REST controller class providing endpoints for uploading documents, creating new document versions, retrieving documents by ID, and obtaining version history, with Swagger annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles POST requests to upload new documents, extracting metadata and initiating storage and processing via ReceiptService, returning an UploadResponse.

methods.name: uploadVersion
methods.description: Handles POST requests to upload a new version of an existing document, updating the document with a new file and OCR reprocessing.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific document by its ID, returning the ReceiptDocument if found.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch all version history of a document specified by ID.
